idea-plugin.name: i18n-doctor
idea-plugin.description:
Live i18n diagnostics for JavaScript & TypeScript

Underlines missing, unused, and duplicate translation keys as you type. Powered by the bundled i18n-doctor language server over LSP — this plugin does not re-implement analysis.

  • t("auth.nonexistent") — underlines exactly "auth.nonexistent"
  • Unused catalog keys — highlighted on the property name in every locale file
  • Live updates for unsaved buffers — no IDE restart
  • No project dependency — the language server is shipped inside the plugin

Requires Node.js ≥ 18. Configure it under Settings → Languages & Frameworks → JavaScript Runtime (or set an explicit Node path under i18n-doctor settings).

Compatible with WebStorm / IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate / PhpStorm and other IDEs that include the platform LSP API (2024.3+).

Docs: packages/jetbrains
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.9.3

Fix Marketplace Plugin Verifier rejection: stop using internal Platform APIs.

  • Resolve plugin path via public PluginPathManager (no PluginManagerCore.getPlugin)
  • Extract bundled server under PathManager.getTempPath() instead of scheduled-for-removal getPluginTempPath

0.9.2

JetBrains Marketplace release.

  • LSP client for the bundled i18n-doctor language server
  • Live diagnostics for missing / unused / duplicate / coverage keys
  • Self-contained server bundle (no project dependency required)
  • Uses WebStorm JavaScript Runtime for Node.js when available
  • Plugin icons for light and dark themes
